raw_html: [[Absorb Doomsphere Spells]] - 8 Charges (Recharged/Day: 8)[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Absorb Doomsphere Spells]]:''' This effect absorbs most spells cast by doomsphere eyestalks. Only a few such spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to dissipate the energy.
